ui-sketch.perceptible-layout-intent.meaning: An implementation instruction that limits a UI sketch to the key interface elements and spatial relationships users can perceive, while excluding component-tree structure and layout-only containers.
ui-sketch.perceptible-layout-intent.scope: Static and motion UI-sketch prompts exported for downstream interface implementation.
ui-sketch.perceptible-layout-intent.referent: The interpretation boundary for rectangles and other nodes in an exported UI-layout draft.
ui-sketch.perceptible-layout-intent.precedence: It governs which draft geometry becomes interface content before responsive and component constraints are applied; an independently perceptible surface may be implemented, while code nesting alone must not create a container.
examples: Implement a visibly bounded card and its primary action when both carry distinct visual meaning.
nonExamples: Create separate interface containers for AppShell, Main, Grid, and Stack solely because they exist in the implementation tree.

ui-sketch.clear-canvas.meaning: A destructive action that removes all user-placed regions, text, and images from the UI sketch while preserving its interface frame, global note, and motion-stage structure.
ui-sketch.clear-canvas.scope: The icon-only action beside the UI-sketch workbench's tool-section heading and its destructive confirmation.
ui-sketch.clear-canvas.referent: The shared canvas content of the current UI sketch across its retained stages.
ui-sketch.clear-canvas.precedence: Broader than deleting selected UI-sketch nodes; distinct from resetting the interface frame and from resetting an entire composition draft to defaults. Clearing draft content is one undoable editor operation in the current open session.
examples: Remove every region, text node, and image while keeping the UI sketch's frame and motion stages.
nonExamples: Reset only the interface frame.
Delete only the selected UI-sketch node.
Delete the UI-sketch session.

ui-sketch.canvas-structure.meaning: The interface editor canvas and its nested navigation viewport and drawing scene.
ui-sketch.canvas-structure.referent: The main editing canvas, its infinite pan/zoom viewport, and the scene rendered inside that viewport.
ui-sketch.canvas-structure.precedence: The canvas contains the viewport, which contains the scene; none is the bounded interface frame being designed.
examples: Name the main editing canvas landmark.
Distinguish its nested pan/zoom region.
nonExamples: Describe the dimensions of the interface frame.

ui-sketch.font-size.meaning: The reference text size in pixels for a UI-sketch text element.
ui-sketch.font-size.scope: UI-sketch text editor and generated layout prompts.
ui-sketch.font-size.referent: The current text element fontSize value.
ui-sketch.font-size.precedence: Not canvas zoom, frame size, visual prominence, or a requirement for pixel-perfect final implementation. Increase and decrease operate in one-pixel steps with a minimum.
examples: Increase the reference text size by one pixel.
Export a suggested text size in a prompt.
nonExamples: Zoom the entire canvas.

ui-sketch.motion-prompt.meaning: Copy an implementation prompt describing the interface initial state and changes leading to its final state.
ui-sketch.motion-prompt.scope: The Motion option in the prompt-copy menu and generated motion prompt instructions.
ui-sketch.motion-prompt.referent: Text produced from the start and end interface states, not a video, animated image, or arbitrary sequence of frames.
ui-sketch.motion-prompt.precedence: Distinct from copying a static single-stage prompt or preview image. Geometry communicates layout intent; unchanged final properties inherit the initial state. Include a node when it is visible and overlaps the interface frame in either the initial or final state; preserve both states for entering and exiting nodes. Omit nodes with no visible overlap in either state.
examples: Copy a prompt describing how an element moves from Start to End.
nonExamples: Download an animation file.
Copy only the End stage as a static layout.

ui-sketch.static-prompt.meaning: A request to design and implement one static interface state from the sketch.
ui-sketch.static-prompt.scope: Static UI-sketch prompt export, including export of a single motion stage.
ui-sketch.static-prompt.referent: The selected stage resolved as a static layout.
ui-sketch.static-prompt.precedence: Includes only visible nodes with positive-area overlap with the interface frame in the selected stage. Partially overlapping nodes retain their complete geometry; fully outside nodes and nodes touching only the frame edge are omitted. Does not describe transitions between stages.
examples: Export only the final stage as a static interface.
nonExamples: Request an animation between two stages.

ui-sketch.prompt-layout-guidance.meaning: Instructions treating sketch geometry as approximate interface layout guidance subject to real content, component and responsive constraints.
ui-sketch.prompt-layout-guidance.scope: Shared layout section of static and motion UI-sketch prompts.
ui-sketch.prompt-layout-guidance.referent: Spatial relationships and reference coordinates, dimensions and font sizes in the exported sketch.
ui-sketch.prompt-layout-guidance.precedence: Complements perceptible-element guidance; does not prescribe fixed positioning or pixel-perfect reproduction and is distinct from image-generation composition instructions.
examples: Adapt reference dimensions to a responsive implementation.
nonExamples: Reproduce every draft coordinate as fixed CSS.

ui-sketch.prompt-geometry.meaning: Pixel-based reference geometry measured relative to the current interface frame.
ui-sketch.prompt-geometry.scope: Static and motion UI-sketch prompt dimensions, origins, positions and sizes.
ui-sketch.prompt-geometry.referent: Rounded interface-frame width and height and frame-relative element geometry.
ui-sketch.prompt-geometry.precedence: The exported origin is the interface frame top-left, not the infinite editor camera. Values are pixels, unlike composition percentage positions, and are recommendations rather than fixed implementation constraints.
examples: Describe a region at x=24px relative to the interface frame.
nonExamples: Describe a region at 24% of an image width.

ui-sketch.prompt-element-list.meaning: The exported list of perceptible interface elements and their layout requirements.
ui-sketch.prompt-element-list.scope: The elements section in static and motion UI-sketch prompts.
ui-sketch.prompt-element-list.referent: Exported regions, text nodes and images selected by the exporter visibility rules.
ui-sketch.prompt-element-list.precedence: A list of perceptible content, not a DOM tree or component nesting specification.
examples: Introduce exported image, region and text descriptions.
nonExamples: List invisible layout-only wrapper components.

ui-sketch.region.meaning: A rectangular draft footprint representing perceptible interface content or a visual surface.
ui-sketch.region.scope: UI-sketch region creation, node editing and exported region headings.
ui-sketch.region.referent: A rectangle node, its editable metadata and its position in exported region order.
ui-sketch.region.precedence: Not an invisible layout wrapper or a composition-image area. Export indices use one-based source rectangle-list positions before visibility filtering, so hidden nodes can leave numbering gaps; they are not stable identifiers.
examples: Add a region for a perceptible card surface.
nonExamples: Add a rectangle only to represent a DOM wrapper.

ui-sketch.text-node.meaning: A draft node containing literal static text shown in the intended interface.
ui-sketch.text-node.scope: UI-sketch text creation controls, node editor and exported text headings.
ui-sketch.text-node.referent: The text node rather than its note or its reference font size.
ui-sketch.text-node.precedence: Distinct from a generic region representing dynamic text content and from a composition text region that can request generated copy. Prompt indices use source text-list positions before visibility filtering, so numbering can have gaps.
examples: Add a static heading text node.
nonExamples: Represent a dynamic list as literal hardcoded text.

ui-sketch.initial-text-content.meaning: The localized initial literal content assigned to a newly created text node.
ui-sketch.initial-text-content.referent: The newly added node text value, editable and stored as user content.
ui-sketch.initial-text-content.precedence: Unlike a tool label, this string becomes draft content and is not replaced merely because the interface locale changes.
examples: Create a text node initially containing Text in the English interface.
nonExamples: Label the Add text tool without creating content.

ui-sketch.empty-text-marker.meaning: An editor-only marker shown when a text node has no displayed text.
ui-sketch.empty-text-marker.scope: UI-sketch canvas rendering, accessible text-node names and editor selected-text preview.
ui-sketch.empty-text-marker.referent: The absence of displayed text in an existing text node.
ui-sketch.empty-text-marker.precedence: Does not write the marker into stored text or request generated copy; absence checks follow each caller rather than modifying the draft.
examples: Show a visible marker for an empty text node while leaving its text empty.
nonExamples: Insert the marker into generated interface copy.

ui-sketch.missing-region-note.meaning: A fallback identifying a region whose note is absent or whitespace-only.
ui-sketch.missing-region-note.scope: UI-sketch region accessible names and editor selected-text preview.
ui-sketch.missing-region-note.referent: An existing region with no nonblank note.
ui-sketch.missing-region-note.precedence: Missing descriptive metadata, not a missing region or an empty text node; the fallback is not saved as a note.
examples: Describe an unnamed region as Region: No note.
nonExamples: Write No note into the region metadata.

ui-sketch.interface-frame.meaning: The bounded interface area being designed within the infinite editing canvas.
ui-sketch.interface-frame.scope: UI-sketch frame heading, dimension controls and canvas frame label.
ui-sketch.interface-frame.referent: The draft frame x, y, width and height.
ui-sketch.interface-frame.precedence: Defines the intended interface and prompt export area within an infinite canvas, without constraining node movement. Nodes outside remain editable and saved; only nodes with visible overlap contribute to the selected-stage prompt. Reset restores default frame geometry without clearing nodes, notes, or stages.
examples: Edit the intended interface width and height.
Reset only frame geometry to defaults.
nonExamples: Fit the viewport without changing frame dimensions.
Clear all interface nodes.

ui-sketch.feature.meaning: The interface layout and state-transition design feature.
ui-sketch.feature.scope: Home-page feature-entry heading and reusable interface feature title.
ui-sketch.feature.referent: The UI-sketch workbench as a product capability.
ui-sketch.feature.precedence: Not an individual session title, a stage name or the nested drawing canvas.
examples: Identify the interface feature above its Start button.
nonExamples: Label a specific user-named interface session.

ui-sketch.selection-count.meaning: The number of selected editable items announced by the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.selection-count.referent: selectedItemKeys.length; the frame is tracked separately and excluded.
ui-sketch.selection-count.precedence: Not total draft-node count or composition selected-ID listing. The current component concatenates prefix + count + suffix; fragments and their whitespace must be used together, not as generic reusable words.
examples: Announce the number of selected sketch elements.
nonExamples: Count every node regardless of selection.
Reuse the suffix as an unrelated item label.

ui-sketch.group-items.meaning: Create a persistent, non-visual, single-level group from selected UI sketch elements so they can be selected and moved together while retaining editable members.
ui-sketch.group-items.referent: The membership relation between selected rectangles, text nodes and images.
ui-sketch.group-items.precedence: Grouping preserves every node, its geometry and stage state. It is independent of visual surfaces, component hierarchy and temporary multi-selection. A padded dashed outline on member hover or group selection is an editor-only membership indicator, not saved or exported content.
examples: Group a button surface with its editable label.
nonExamples: Draw a container around a button.
Group sessions under a project.
Copy a preview image.

ui-sketch.ungroup-items.meaning: Remove selected persistent UI sketch groups while retaining their individual elements, content, geometry and stage states.
ui-sketch.ungroup-items.referent: Existing group membership relations touched by the selection.
ui-sketch.ungroup-items.precedence: Removes membership only; does not delete elements or clear the canvas.
examples: Separate a button label from its surface for independent movement.
nonExamples: Delete a button and its label.
Deselect a group.

ui-sketch.missing-state.meaning: The requested UI state id is absent from the saved document’s editable state tabs.
ui-sketch.missing-state.scope: UI state selection for CLI preview export.
ui-sketch.missing-state.referent: The stable state id requested by the Agent.
ui-sketch.missing-state.precedence: An absent or deleted state must not silently select a different state.
examples: Render a state that was deleted from this revision.
nonExamples: Render an existing state with no visible nodes.

ui-sketch.preview-output-format.meaning: The CLI preview destination must use a supported PNG or SVG filename extension.
ui-sketch.preview-output-format.referent: The local output filename and its format.
ui-sketch.preview-output-format.precedence: Export format is independent of the source image asset format.
examples: Reject a preview destination ending in .jpg.
nonExamples: Reject an uploaded JPEG image.

ui-sketch.png-split.meaning: Split one selected transparent PNG original into independent native-size images, filtering only pieces with both dimensions below the minimum and grouping the newly added pieces.
ui-sketch.png-split.scope: Single ungrouped image selection in the UI-sketch canvas; unavailable for multi-selection, groups, non-image nodes and session preview references.
ui-sketch.png-split.referent: The one selected original image asset and its recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split.precedence: Preserves the source image and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis. The menu action opens settings with read-only preview; only confirmation executes splitting.
examples: Select one original PNG, open Split PNG settings, inspect the preview and confirm to create retained slices.
nonExamples: Split a group or multiple selected images.
Replace or delete the source image; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-alpha-threshold.meaning: The alpha cutoff used only for eight-direction connectivity; original soft-edge RGBA pixels are preserved and assigned to the nearest body.
ui-sketch.png-split-alpha-threshold.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-alpha-threshold.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-alpha-threshold.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-minimum-size.meaning: Minimum original pixel dimension for automatically detected pieces: discard only when both width and height are smaller, retaining thin pieces. Zero disables filtering. Explicit manual regions are always retained when nonempty.
ui-sketch.png-split-minimum-size.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-minimum-size.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-minimum-size.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-gap.meaning: Space in canvas pixels between native-size pieces in the compact rectangle. It does not scale or rotate images.
ui-sketch.png-split-gap.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-gap.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-gap.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-failure.meaning: Splitting or saving slice assets failed before committing canvas content; retry resumes recorded successful assets.
ui-sketch.png-split-failure.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-failure.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-failure.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-invalid-input.meaning: The selection contains an image that is not a static PNG with an alpha channel, fully transparent pixels and at least one nontransparent pixel.
ui-sketch.png-split-invalid-input.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas and ordinary-image input validation in its CLI.
ui-sketch.png-split-invalid-input.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-invalid-input.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
searchTerms: 请选择包含透明区域且非空的静态 PNG 图片。
Select nonempty static PNG images with transparent areas.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-completion.meaning: The operation completed, reporting retained slices and discarded fragments across the selected originals. Zero retained slices is also successful.
ui-sketch.png-split-completion.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-completion.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-completion.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
searchTerms: 已拆分 {{count}} 张图片，过滤 {{discarded}} 个碎片。
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-repeat.meaning: Every requested source and connectivity/size-filter parameter combination has already been applied; preserve edited, deleted and ungrouped results.
ui-sketch.png-split-repeat.scope: Selected-image PNG splitting in the UI-sketch canvas.
ui-sketch.png-split-repeat.referent: The selected original image assets and their recorded split operation.
ui-sketch.png-split-repeat.precedence: Preserves source images and user edits; distinct from crop, replacement, grouping existing nodes and semantic image analysis.
searchTerms: Selected images have already been split.
examples: Split one or more selected transparent PNG assets without resizing their retained slices.
nonExamples: Replace or delete source images; restore deleted slices on rerun.

ui-sketch.png-split-save-retry.meaning: Retry saving the current UI-sketch draft after a failed nonconflicting save of a PNG split operation, retaining prepared slice assets and the single local undo step.
ui-sketch.png-split-save-retry.scope: UI-sketch service error action when a PNG split remains unsaved.
ui-sketch.png-split-save-retry.referent: The current unsaved full draft containing PNG split provenance.
ui-sketch.png-split-save-retry.precedence: Retries existing draft persistence without repeating splitting or creating nodes. Revision conflicts continue to stop writes. Distinct from reloading a failed session or retrying asset preparation.
examples: A split has appended six images locally but its save request fails; retry the pending draft.
nonExamples: Overwrite a newer external draft on revision conflict.

ui-sketch.png-split-settings.meaning: Preview one selected original PNG with retained slice bounds while editing alpha threshold, minimum native piece size and packing gap; confirm to execute splitting with these parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-settings.scope: UI-sketch PNG split settings dialog and confirmation button, opened by the Split PNG menu action.
ui-sketch.png-split-settings.referent: PNG split parameters remembered in the current browser; valid input is saved automatically and restored when settings reopen.
ui-sketch.png-split-settings.precedence: Editing settings saves valid parameter preferences locally and computes read-only bounds; no slice assets, draft changes or undo entries are created until Split is clicked. Closing keeps saved preferences without splitting. Gap affects output packing, not source bounds.
examples: Adjust the minimum size, inspect retained bounds over the selected original, then confirm to create slices.
nonExamples: Create slice assets while typing parameters.
Execute splitting when closing settings.

ui-sketch.png-split-progress.meaning: Transient feedback while preparing slices from selected PNG assets before their atomic canvas insertion.
ui-sketch.png-split-progress.scope: UI-sketch canvas status after confirming PNG split settings.
ui-sketch.png-split-progress.referent: The pending selected-image PNG split preparation request.
ui-sketch.png-split-progress.precedence: Does not open parameter settings or imply completion, partial canvas insertion or draft-save completion.
examples: Announce preparation after confirming PNG split settings.
nonExamples: Announce that a draft has finished saving.

ui-sketch.png-split-preview.meaning: The selected original PNG overlaid with retained slice bounds from prioritized manual regions and automatic detection using valid threshold and minimum size.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview.referent: The single selected PNG source and unconfirmed parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview.precedence: Describes read-only preview, not completed splitting or saved canvas content.
examples: Inspect retained bounds before confirming a split.
nonExamples: Report that slices have already been saved.

ui-sketch.png-split-previewing.meaning: A read-only split-bounds preview is being computed for the current parameters; no slices have been created.
ui-sketch.png-split-previewing.referent: The current selected PNG sources and unconfirmed parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-previewing.precedence: Describes read-only preview, not completed splitting or saved canvas content.
examples: Inspect retained bounds before confirming a split.
nonExamples: Report that slices have already been saved.

ui-sketch.png-split-preview-failure.meaning: Read-only PNG split preview could not be computed; retry the preview before confirming.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview-failure.referent: The current selected PNG sources and unconfirmed parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview-failure.precedence: Describes read-only preview, not completed splitting or saved canvas content.
examples: Inspect retained bounds before confirming a split.
nonExamples: Report that slices have already been saved.

ui-sketch.png-split-preview-summary.meaning: Counts of retained slices and discarded fragments predicted for all selected originals using the current parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview-summary.referent: The current selected PNG sources and unconfirmed parameters.
ui-sketch.png-split-preview-summary.precedence: Describes read-only preview, not completed splitting or saved canvas content.
examples: Inspect retained bounds before confirming a split.
nonExamples: Report that slices have already been saved.

ui-sketch.png-manual-region.meaning: A closed polygon drawn with free anchor points that forces all enclosed source pixels into one PNG image before automatic detection processes the remainder.
ui-sketch.png-manual-region.scope: PNG split preview editor; polygons are created, selected or deleted, never reshaped after closure.
ui-sketch.png-manual-region.referent: Source-image pixel coordinates of one manual split region.
ui-sketch.png-manual-region.precedence: Manual regions bypass automatic connectivity and minimum-size filtering. Earlier regions own overlapping pixels. Empty regions produce no image. Region drafts belong to the currently open image dialog, not shared numeric preferences.
examples: Close a polygon around one touching object and split it as one image.
Select a completed region and delete it before drawing a replacement.
nonExamples: Drag a completed polygon vertex.
Create vector nodes from a polygon.

uiSketch.canvasLabels.clearCanvasConfirm.role: title of the destructive confirmation shown before clearing UI-sketch content
uiSketch.canvasLabels.clearCanvasConfirm.duplicateReason: It intentionally parallels composition.clearCanvasConfirmTitle, but the UI-sketch action preserves the frame, global note, and motion-stage structure.

uiSketch.canvasLabels.clearCanvasConfirm.role: consequence statement in the destructive confirmation shown before clearing UI-sketch content
